files.description: Repo-wide rules: PR workflow, SOLID, code style, design system, testing and infrastructure cost discipline.
Web design tokens and the lint guardrails that enforce them.

rules.rule: Follow SOLID: one reason to change per module, extend by composition rather than modification, keep interfaces small and focused, and import abstractions from src/lib instead of instantiating clients in components.

Web UI uses the design system's semantic token classes (bg-bg, text-fg-muted, border-border) and scale tokens (bg-primary-500), never raw Tailwind greys (bg-gray-*, text-slate-*) or arbitrary color, shadow or radius values (bg-[#...], shadow-[...], rounded-[...]).
apps/mobile/src/db and apps/desktop/src/db (schema, migrations, models) must stay in sync: a change to one needs the same change to the other in the same PR.
